query:
UPDATE nfts
            SET
                collection_id = (SELECT id FROM collections WHERE hash = ?),
                minter_hash = ?,
                owner_hash = ?,
                metadata = ?,
                metadata_updater_puzzle_hash = ?,
                metadata_updater_kind = ?,
                display_name = ?,
                royalty_puzzle_hash = ?,
                royalty_basis_points = ?,
                data_hash = ?,
                metadata_hash = ?,
                license_hash = ?,
                edition_number = ?,
                edition_total = ?
            WHERE asset_id = (SELECT id FROM assets WHERE hash = ?)
